prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one finished original game environment asset for Starlight Cat Town, an interactive personal portfolio. View from the open front of a room, slightly elevated, straight-on wide dollhouse cutaway, full room fills the image. Strong indigo/blue shadows, warm amber practical lights, jewel greens and floral color accents, wooden textures, tiny star motifs. Clear room proportions and legible interactive furniture. No text, no lettering, no UI, no border, no watermark, no people. One small cat fits naturally in the room. Keep top 10% relatively quiet for the site's separate navigation. Left: a desk with small glowing blue prototype monitor, mechanical components and technical books. Center: a large wooden workbench with inventive miniature devices, translucent blue models and an open blueprint. Right: a tall wall display of diagrams without writing, brass telescope parts and tool storage. Indigo starry windows. Main clickable workbench centered at x50% y60%, left bookshelf x23% y54%, right drafting board x77% y50%. An orange cat sits on a stool. Scientific creativity and craftsmanship, not industrial dystopia.
